validation.title: Validation criteria
validation.description: Define when an ad has enough data to be judged. Ads that don't meet it stay in the testing phase and are left out of G.O.L.D., the action plan and the opportunities. It's the same builder used by the Manager filters and the Boards groups.

leadscore.title: Leadscore settings
leadscore.description: The minimum leadscore to consider a lead an MQL is defined in each pack, together with the spreadsheet that produces the leadscore — it sets the scale of the number. There's no account-wide default anymore: the criterion follows the pack, including when it's shared.
leadscore.current: In effect for the current selection
leadscore.divergent: The selected packs use different cutoffs, so MQL and CPMQL are unavailable. Select one pack at a time or align the cutoff in Packs → settings.
leadscore.missing: No cutoff defined for the selected packs — MQL and CPMQL are unavailable. Set it in Packs → settings.
leadscore.applied: Leads with leadscore >= {value} count as MQL. To change it, use Packs → settings.

ads_read.label: Read ad data
ads_read.impact: Without this permission the connection is useless — no ad account can be read. Reconnect and authorize all permissions.

ads_management.label: Manage ads
ads_management.impact: You'll be able to view your ads, but you won't be able to create, edit or pause ads through Hookify.

business_management.label: Manage Business Manager
business_management.impact: Ad accounts linked to a Business Manager won't show up or update — only personal accounts.

pages_show_list.label: List Pages
pages_show_list.impact: Without this permission Hookify can't get the Page Access Token, which is needed to read media for many ads. Thumbnails, videos and previews may break, and you won't be able to create new ads (the Page selector stays empty).

pages_read_engagement.label: Read Page engagement
pages_read_engagement.impact: Some advanced Page reads may fail (organic post insights, specific reads).
